# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Verified that the branch already contains the approved tanksim-6e5.6.3 molt/mineral fixes, so this apply-fixes pass was validation-only and required no source edits. I rechecked the current shrimp GH/cadence guard wiring and reran focused molt/validation coverage plus the full `tank_core`, `tank_data`, and `tank_scenarios` suites; all passed on current HEAD.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspected the current worktree and the relevant shrimp molt/mineral parameter and regression paths to confirm the approved fixes were already present before making any edits.
2. [Completed] Ran formatting checks and focused `tank_core` regressions for molt/mineral and runtime validation behavior.
3. [Completed] Ran the full `tank_core` suite plus downstream `tank_data` and `tank_scenarios` tests to confirm broader stability, then recorded this stage as validation-only because no new code changes were needed.

## Validation Evidence

- `git status --short`
- `rg -n "critical_molt_gh_ratio|temp_condition_min_factor|test_zero_gh_min_parameter_uses_defensive_guard|test_temp_condition_min_factor_controls_molt_cadence_floor" crates/tank_core crates/tank_data crates/tank_scenarios`
- `cargo fmt --all --check`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test molt_mineral_budget -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test validation -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_data -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_scenarios -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core -- --nocapture`
